Golden Hours in Severe Paraquat Poisoning-The Role of Early Haemoperfusion Therapy. INTRODUCTION Paraquat is a commonly ingested poison especially in Southern India. There is no antidote for paraquat poison and consumption is often fatal. The usual cause of death is either acute lung injury or multi-organ failure. AIM To evaluate the role of early haemoperfusion as a therapy in paraquat poisoned patients. MATERIALS AND METHODS This study was a retrospective analysis of patients admitted to a Tertiary Medical College Hospital between January 2012 and December 2015 with history of paraquat consumption, comparing outcomes in those who received only gastric lavage and symptomatic treatment with those who received haemoperfusion as a therapy.
